headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes at 332.75/85 to US dollar spot, bond yields flat
summary: The rupee closed at 332.75/85 to the US dollar on Thursday, from 332.73/80 the previous day. A 2029 bond closed flat at 10.65/75 percent while a 2030 bond closed at 11.00/05 percent.
why: The rupee's exchange rate and local bond yields reflect Sri Lanka's external financing conditions. Investors track both when assessing sovereign debt risk.
